---
title: "Integration analysis"
format: html
---

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Integrated fungal–viral–host profile analysis
# Candidate microbial taxa vs host/clinical features
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(pheatmap)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# File paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

project_root <- "C:/Users/valfr/OneDrive/Documents/Masters/Research Project"

data_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Data")
results_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Results")
figures_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Figures")

metadata_file_tsv <- file.path(data_dir, "metadata_clean.tsv")

fungal_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_fungal_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

viral_file <- file.path(
  data_dir,
  "refseq_viral_genus_2pct.totalcount_gt_1.prevalence_0p02.tsv"
)

out_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "integrated_profile_analysis")
fig_out_dir <- file.path(figures_dir, "integrated_profile_analysis")

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Candidate microbial and host features
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fungal_candidates <- c(
  "Aspergillus",
  "Fusarium",
  "Cryptococcus",
  "Puccinia",
  "Saccharomyces",
  "Trichoderma"
)

viral_candidates <- c(
  "Shenzhenivirus",
  "Fohxhuevirus"
)

host_features <- c(
  "IL37_pg_mL",
  "IL6",
  "Succinate",
  "Lactate",
  "Putrescine",
  "Ges_del_days"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Feature labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

feature_labels <- c(
  "Aspergillus" = "Aspergillus",
  "Fusarium" = "Fusarium",
  "Cryptococcus" = "Cryptococcus",
  "Puccinia" = "Puccinia",
  "Saccharomyces" = "Saccharomyces",
  "Trichoderma" = "Trichoderma",
  "Shenzhenivirus" = "Shenzhenivirus",
  "Fohxhuevirus" = "Fohxhuevirus",
  "IL37_pg_mL" = "IL-37",
  "IL6" = "IL-6",
  "Succinate" = "Succinate",
  "Lactate" = "Lactate",
  "Putrescine" = "Putrescine",
  "Ges_del_days" = "Gestational age at delivery (days)"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Read metadata
# ------------------------------------------------------------

meta <- read.delim(
  metadata_file_tsv,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

colnames(meta)[1] <- "sample_label"

meta$bmi <- as.numeric(meta$bmi)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Read microbial matrices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fungal_mat <- read.delim(
  fungal_file,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

viral_mat <- read.delim(
  viral_file,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean sequencing IDs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rownames(fungal_mat) <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(fungal_mat))
rownames(viral_mat) <- sub("_1$", "", rownames(viral_mat))

shared_ids <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  list(
    rownames(fungal_mat),
    rownames(viral_mat),
    meta$reads_ID
  )
)

if (length(shared_ids) == 0) {
  stop("No shared sample IDs found across fungal, viral, and metadata files.")
}

fungal_mat <- fungal_mat[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
viral_mat <- viral_mat[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]

meta <- meta[
  match(shared_ids, meta$reads_ID),
]

if (!all(meta$reads_ID == shared_ids)) {
  stop("Metadata order mismatch after matching.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check that requested features are present
# ------------------------------------------------------------

missing_fungi <- setdiff(fungal_candidates, colnames(fungal_mat))
missing_viruses <- setdiff(viral_candidates, colnames(viral_mat))
missing_host <- setdiff(host_features, colnames(meta))

if (length(missing_fungi) > 0) {
  warning("Missing fungal taxa: ", paste(missing_fungi, collapse = ", "))
}

if (length(missing_viruses) > 0) {
  warning("Missing viral taxa: ", paste(missing_viruses, collapse = ", "))
}

if (length(missing_host) > 0) {
  warning("Missing host features: ", paste(missing_host, collapse = ", "))
}

fungal_present <- intersect(fungal_candidates, colnames(fungal_mat))
viral_present <- intersect(viral_candidates, colnames(viral_mat))
host_present <- intersect(host_features, colnames(meta))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Build microbial and host matrices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

microbial_profile <- cbind(
  fungal_mat[, fungal_present, drop = FALSE],
  viral_mat[, viral_present, drop = FALSE]
)

host_profile <- meta[, host_present, drop = FALSE]

microbial_profile <- as.data.frame(microbial_profile)
host_profile <- as.data.frame(host_profile)

microbial_profile[] <- lapply(
  microbial_profile,
  function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))
)

host_profile[] <- lapply(
  host_profile,
  function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))
)

rownames(microbial_profile) <- meta$reads_ID
rownames(host_profile) <- meta$reads_ID

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Remove unusable features
# ------------------------------------------------------------

keep_microbes <- sapply(microbial_profile, function(x) {
  sum(!is.na(x)) >= 5 && sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
})

keep_host <- sapply(host_profile, function(x) {
  sum(!is.na(x)) >= 5 && sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
})

microbial_profile <- microbial_profile[, keep_microbes, drop = FALSE]
host_profile <- host_profile[, keep_host, drop = FALSE]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Run targeted Spearman correlations
# Microbial taxa are tested only against host/clinical features
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cor_results <- list()

for (microbe in colnames(microbial_profile)) {
  
  for (host in colnames(host_profile)) {
    
    test_df <- data.frame(
      microbe_value = microbial_profile[[microbe]],
      host_value = host_profile[[host]]
    ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(microbe_value), !is.na(host_value))
    
    if (nrow(test_df) >= 5) {
      
      cor_test <- suppressWarnings(
        cor.test(
          test_df$microbe_value,
          test_df$host_value,
          method = "spearman",
          exact = FALSE
        )
      )
      
      cor_results[[paste(microbe, host, sep = "___")]] <- data.frame(
        microbial_feature = microbe,
        host_feature = host,
        n_samples = nrow(test_df),
        spearman_rho = unname(cor_test$estimate),
        p_value = cor_test$p.value
      )
    }
  }
}

cor_results_df <- bind_rows(cor_results) %>%
  mutate(
    q_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    direction = case_when(
      spearman_rho > 0 ~ "positive",
      spearman_rho < 0 ~ "negative",
      TRUE ~ "none"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

write.csv(
  cor_results_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "targeted_microbe_host_spearman_results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert targeted correlations into heatmap matrices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rho_matrix <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = ncol(microbial_profile),
  ncol = ncol(host_profile),
  dimnames = list(
    colnames(microbial_profile),
    colnames(host_profile)
  )
)

q_matrix <- rho_matrix
p_matrix <- rho_matrix

for (i in seq_len(nrow(cor_results_df))) {
  
  microbe <- cor_results_df$microbial_feature[i]
  host <- cor_results_df$host_feature[i]
  
  rho_matrix[microbe, host] <- cor_results_df$spearman_rho[i]
  p_matrix[microbe, host] <- cor_results_df$p_value[i]
  q_matrix[microbe, host] <- cor_results_df$q_value[i]
}

write.csv(rho_matrix, file.path(out_dir, "targeted_microbe_host_rho_matrix.csv"))
write.csv(p_matrix, file.path(out_dir, "targeted_microbe_host_pvalue_matrix.csv"))
write.csv(q_matrix, file.path(out_dir, "targeted_microbe_host_qvalue_matrix.csv"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Targeted microbe-host correlation heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rho_matrix_plot <- rho_matrix

rownames(rho_matrix_plot) <- feature_labels[rownames(rho_matrix_plot)]
colnames(rho_matrix_plot) <- feature_labels[colnames(rho_matrix_plot)]

heatmap_colours <- colorRampPalette(
  c("#313695", "#74add1", "white", "#f46d43", "#a50026")
)(100)

pheatmap(
  rho_matrix_plot,
  color = heatmap_colours,
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  fontsize_col = 9,
  fontsize_row = 9,
  angle_col = 45,
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Associations between candidate microbial taxa and host features",
  filename = file.path(
    fig_out_dir,
    "targeted_microbe_host_correlation_heatmap.png"
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Sample-level integrated profile heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Create delivery group using your strict colour scheme
meta$birth_group <- dplyr::case_when(
  meta$outcome == "TERM" ~ "TERM",
  meta$outcome == "sPTB" & meta$sPTB34 == "no" ~ "sPTB 34–37",
  meta$outcome == "sPTB" & meta$sPTB34 == "yes" ~ "sPTB <34",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

# Combine microbial and host features
integrated_profile <- cbind(
  microbial_profile,
  host_profile
)

# Keep samples as rows and features as columns
heat_mat <- integrated_profile

# Log-transform microbial abundance columns only
microbial_cols <- colnames(microbial_profile)

pseudocount <- 1e-6

heat_mat[, microbial_cols] <- log10(heat_mat[, microbial_cols] + pseudocount)

# Convert all features to comparable z-scores
heat_mat <- scale(heat_mat)

colnames(heat_mat) <- feature_labels[colnames(heat_mat)]

# Use sample labels as rownames for internal matching, but do not display them
rownames(heat_mat) <- meta$sample_label

# Row annotation: delivery group
row_annotation <- data.frame(
  Delivery_group = meta$birth_group
)

rownames(row_annotation) <- meta$sample_label

# Match your existing delivery-group colours
annotation_colours <- list(
  Delivery_group = c(
    "TERM" = "#1f77b4",
    "sPTB 34–37" = "#9467bd",
    "sPTB <34" = "#ff7f0e"
  )
)

# Match your existing heatmap colour palette
heatmap_colours <- colorRampPalette(
  c("#440154", "#31688e", "#35b779", "#fde725")
)(100)

pheatmap(
  heat_mat,
  color = heatmap_colours,
  annotation_row = row_annotation,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colours,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  scale = "none",
  fontsize_col = 8,
  fontsize_row = 6,
  angle_col = 90,
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Integrated microbial and host feature profile",
  filename = file.path(
    fig_out_dir,
    "sample_level_integrated_profile_heatmap.png"
  ),
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Scatterplots for strongest targeted correlations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_df <- cbind(
  reads_ID = meta$reads_ID,
  sample_label = meta$sample_label,
  outcome = meta$outcome,
  sPTB34 = meta$sPTB34,
  microbial_profile,
  host_profile
) %>%
  as.data.frame()

top_pairs <- cor_results_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value)) %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(top_pairs))) {
  
  microbe <- top_pairs$microbial_feature[i]
  host <- top_pairs$host_feature[i]
  
  microbe_label <- feature_labels[microbe]
  host_label <- feature_labels[host]
  
  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = .data[[microbe]],
      y = .data[[host]],
      colour = outcome
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(
        "TERM" = "#1f77b4",
        "sPTB" = "#ff7f0e"
      )
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste(microbe_label, "vs", host_label),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "\u03c1 = ",
        round(top_pairs$spearman_rho[i], 2),
        ", p = ",
        signif(top_pairs$p_value[i], 2),
        ", FDR = ",
        signif(top_pairs$q_value[i], 2)
      ),
      x = microbe_label,
      y = host_label,
      colour = "Outcome"
    )
  
  safe_name <- paste0(
    "scatter_",
    i,
    "_",
    gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", microbe),
    "_vs_",
    gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", host),
    ".png"
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(fig_out_dir, safe_name),
    plot = p,
    width = 6.5,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Save analysis summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------

summary_table <- data.frame(
  item = c(
    "Samples included",
    "Fungal taxa included",
    "Viral taxa included",
    "Host features included",
    "Total targeted correlations tested"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(microbial_profile),
    paste(intersect(fungal_present, colnames(microbial_profile)), collapse = ", "),
    paste(intersect(viral_present, colnames(microbial_profile)), collapse = ", "),
    paste(colnames(host_profile), collapse = ", "),
    nrow(cor_results_df)
  )
)

write.csv(
  summary_table,
  file.path(out_dir, "targeted_integrated_profile_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nIntegrated fungal–viral–host profile analysis complete.\n")
cat("Results saved to:\n", out_dir, "\n")
cat("Figures saved to:\n", fig_out_dir, "\n")
```
